package retirementcontract

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	cnpgv1 "github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/api/v1"
	provider "github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/internal/management/controller"
	"github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pkg/management/postgres"
	"github.com/cloudnative-pg/cloudnative-pg/pkg/utils"
	platform "github.com/splunk/splunk-operator/api/platform/v1alpha1"
	adapter "github.com/splunk/splunk-operator/pkg/postgresql/database/adapter/cnpg"
	core "github.com/splunk/splunk-operator/pkg/postgresql/database/core"
	pgconninfo "github.com/splunk/splunk-operator/pkg/postgresql/shared/connectioninfo"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	corev1 "k8s.io/api/core/v1"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/equality"
	apierrors "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/api/errors"
	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
	"k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/runtime"
	ctrl "sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client/fake"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/client/interceptor"
	"sigs.k8s.io/controller-runtime/pkg/manager"
)

type providerManager struct {
	manager.Manager
	client client.Client
}

func (m providerManager) GetClient() client.Client { return m.client }

func TestRetainedDatabaseProviderFinalization(t *testing.T) {
	scheme := runtime.NewScheme()
	require.NoError(t, cnpgv1.AddToScheme(scheme))
	require.NoError(t, platform.AddToScheme(scheme))
	require.NoError(t, corev1.AddToScheme(scheme))
	now := metav1.Now()
	parent := &platform.PostgresCluster{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "parent", Namespace: "ns", UID: "parent"}}
	child := &platform.PostgresDatabase{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "child", Namespace: "ns", UID: "child", Generation: 1}, Spec: platform.PostgresDatabaseSpec{ClusterRef: corev1.LocalObjectReference{Name: parent.Name}, Databases: []platform.DatabaseDefinition{{Name: "app"}}}}
	owned := []metav1.OwnerReference{*metav1.NewControllerRef(parent, platform.GroupVersion.WithKind("PostgresCluster"))}
	active := &cnpgv1.Cluster{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "active", Namespace: "ns", UID: "active", OwnerReferences: owned}, Status: cnpgv1.ClusterStatus{WriteService: "active-rw"}}
	retired := &cnpgv1.Cluster{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "retired", Namespace: "ns", UID: "retired", OwnerReferences: owned}, Status: cnpgv1.ClusterStatus{CurrentPrimary: "retired-1", TargetPrimary: "retired-1"}}
	ref := func(kind string, obj client.Object) corev1.ObjectReference {
		return corev1.ObjectReference{APIVersion: cnpgv1.SchemeGroupVersion.String(), Kind: kind, Namespace: obj.GetNamespace(), Name: obj.GetName(), UID: obj.GetUID()}
	}
	activeRef, retiredRef := ref("Cluster", active), ref("Cluster", retired)
	db := &cnpgv1.Database{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "declaration", Namespace: "ns", UID: "declaration", Generation: 1, Finalizers: []string{utils.DatabaseFinalizerName}, OwnerReferences: []metav1.OwnerReference{*metav1.NewControllerRef(child, platform.GroupVersion.WithKind("PostgresDatabase"))}}, Spec: cnpgv1.DatabaseSpec{Name: "app", Owner: "app", ClusterRef: corev1.LocalObjectReference{Name: retired.Name}, Ensure: cnpgv1.EnsurePresent, ReclaimPolicy: cnpgv1.DatabaseReclaimDelete}}
	db.SetAsReady()
	parent.Status.ProvisionerRef = &activeRef
	parent.Status.Resources = &platform.PostgresClusterResources{ConfigMapRef: &corev1.LocalObjectReference{Name: "canonical"}}
	parent.Status.PostgresMajorUpgradeStatus = []platform.PostgresMajorUpgradeStatus{{Phase: new("Cancelled"), Strategy: new("blueGreen"), BlueGreen: &platform.PostgresBlueGreenUpgradeStatus{
		AttemptID: "attempt", Blue: &platform.BlueGreenEnvironmentStatus{Ref: activeRef}, Green: &platform.BlueGreenEnvironmentStatus{Ref: retiredRef},
		Gates:   &platform.BlueGreenGateStatus{Cleanup: &platform.BlueGreenGateConsumptionStatus{Generation: 1, ConsumedAt: &now}, Cancellation: &platform.BlueGreenCancellationStatus{RequestedAt: &now, SourceAccessRestoredAt: &now, ReplicationRemovedAt: &now, CredentialsRemovedAt: &now, GreenFencedAt: &now, CompletedAt: &now}},
		Cleanup: &platform.BlueGreenCleanupStatus{State: platform.BlueGreenCleanupStateCleaning, StartedAt: &now, RetirementGeneration: new(int64(1)), EnvironmentRef: &retiredRef, RetirementAcknowledgements: []platform.BlueGreenRetirementAcknowledgementStatus{{PostgresDatabaseName: child.Name, PostgresDatabaseUID: string(child.UID), PostgresDatabaseGeneration: child.Generation, DatabaseName: "app", Resources: []corev1.ObjectReference{ref("Database", db)}}}},
	}}}
	canonical := &corev1.ConfigMap{ObjectMeta: metav1.ObjectMeta{Name: "canonical", Namespace: "ns", OwnerReferences: owned}, Data: map[string]string{pgconninfo.KeyClusterRWEndpoint: "active-rw.ns.svc.cluster.local"}}
	backing := fake.NewClientBuilder().WithScheme(scheme).WithStatusSubresource(parent, child, db).WithObjects(parent, child, active, retired, db, canonical).Build()
	c := interceptor.NewClient(backing, interceptor.Funcs{Patch: func(ctx context.Context, next client.WithWatch, obj client.Object, patch client.Patch, opts ...client.PatchOption) error {
		before := &cnpgv1.Database{}
		if _, ok := obj.(*cnpgv1.Database); ok {
			require.NoError(t, next.Get(ctx, client.ObjectKeyFromObject(obj), before))
		}
		if err := next.Patch(ctx, obj, patch, opts...); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if actual, ok := obj.(*cnpgv1.Database); ok && !equality.Semantic.DeepEqual(before.Spec, actual.Spec) {
			actual.Generation++ // The fake client does not implement API-server generation updates.
			return next.Update(ctx, actual)
		}
		return nil
	}})
	rc := &core.ReconcileContext{Client: c, APIReader: c, Scheme: scheme, EnvironmentRetirer: adapter.NewEnvironmentRetirer(c, c)}
	childPass := func() {
		t.Helper()
		require.NoError(t, c.Get(t.Context(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(child), child))
		_, err := core.PostgresDatabaseService(t.Context(), rc, child, nil)
		require.NoError(t, err)
	}
	instance := postgres.NewInstance().WithNamespace("ns").WithClusterName(retired.Name).WithPodName("retired-1")
	reconciler := provider.NewDatabaseReconciler(providerManager{client: c}, instance, nil)
	providerPass := func() {
		t.Helper()
		_, err := reconciler.Reconcile(t.Context(), ctrl.Request{NamespacedName: client.ObjectKeyFromObject(db)})
		require.NoError(t, err)
	}
	childPass()
	require.NoError(t, c.Get(t.Context(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(db), db))
	require.Equal(t, cnpgv1.DatabaseReclaimRetain, db.Spec.ReclaimPolicy)
	// Simulate the provider applying Retain before the subsequent delete request.
	db.SetAsReady()
	require.NoError(t, c.Status().Update(t.Context(), db))
	childPass()
	providerPass()
	require.NoError(t, c.Get(t.Context(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(db), db))
	require.NotNil(t, db.DeletionTimestamp)
	require.Contains(t, db.Finalizers, utils.DatabaseFinalizerName, "the pinned provider shortcut leaves this generation pending")
	childPass()
	require.NoError(t, c.Get(t.Context(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(db), db))
	require.NotEqual(t, db.Generation, db.Status.ObservedGeneration)
	require.Nil(t, child.Status.EnvironmentRetirement)
	providerPass()
	require.True(t, apierrors.IsNotFound(c.Get(t.Context(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(db), db)), "only the provider releases its finalizer")
	childPass()
	require.NoError(t, c.Get(t.Context(), client.ObjectKeyFromObject(child), child))
	require.NotNil(t, child.Status.EnvironmentRetirement)
	require.NotNil(t, child.Status.EnvironmentRetirement.Databases[0].AcknowledgedAt)
}
